# OpenAX

> The web was built for human eyes, we're fixing that for agents.

Agents use the web by looking at it. They screenshot the page, send it to
a model and get back a place to click. Then they do it all again. Every step
costs image tokens and every click is a guess. It breaks whenever the layout
changes. But the page already knows what it can do. So OpenAX flips it: pages
list the tools they offer and the browser runs the calls in your own tab.
Nothing to read from pixels. Nothing to guess. Being usable by agents stops
being extra work and starts being part of the page.

## Links

- [OpenAX on GitHub](https://github.com/open-ax): the organization, built in the open
- [ax-kit](https://github.com/open-ax/ax-kit): the implementation
- [WebMCP draft](https://webmachinelearning.github.io/webmcp/): the spec ax-kit follows, from the W3C Web Machine Learning Community Group
- [W3C Web Machine Learning Community Group](https://www.w3.org/community/webmachinelearning/)
- [OpenAX on X](https://x.com/getaxkit)
- Contact: contactopenax@gmail.com
